'''December 2000 Huntsville tournament (30 December)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Huntsville, AL on 30 December 2000. [[Andy McClure]] won it. It is known from Tom Culpepper's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1582">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-31-huntsville-al-30-12-00d1582/ huntsville-al-30-12-00], DeckTech (Tom "Gand" Culpepper, 31 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-31-huntsville-al-30-12-00d1582/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Huntsville, AL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Andy McClure]]
